name: Cello World Limited
summary: Cello World Limited manufactures and sells consumer houseware and glassware products in India and internationally. The company offers vacuum-insulated steel products, including flasks, bottles, sports bottles, kids' bottles, mugs, tiffin's, soup and food jars, serving pots, and beverage dispensers, as well as hot pots, lunch packs, water jugs, single-walled steel bottles, and containers. It also provides opalware; and glassware, such as tumblers, bottles, jugs, hot drinks, storage containers, mixing bowls, and lunch boxes.
